代码改动

工具入口

func (m *VQA) StreamFunc(ctx context.Context, request *types.ChatRequest) (<-chan *types.ChatResponse, error) {
    ch := make(chan *types.ChatResponse, 16)

    pkg_util.GoSafe(ctx, "VQA.StreamFunc", func() {
       defer close(ch)

       prepareResult, err := vqa.BuildPrepareResult(ctx, request)
       if err != nil {
          log.AppLogger.Error(ctx, "BuildPrepareResult failed, err: %+v", err)
          ch <- types.NewModelContentChunk(vqa_v2.GetBuildPrepareErrorResponse(err))
          return
       }

       captureResult, err := vqa.BuildCaptureResult(ctx, request, prepareResult)
       if err != nil {
          log.AppLogger.Error(ctx, "BuildCaptureResult failed, err: %+v", err)
          ch <- types.NewModelContentChunk(vqa_v2.GetBuildPrepareErrorResponse(err))
          return
       }

       if err := vqa.RunScene(ctx, request, prepareResult, captureResult, ch); err != nil {
          return
       }
    })
    return ch, nil
}

准备阶段

func collectPrepareInputs(
    ctx context.Context,
    req *types.ChatRequest,
    commonOutput map[string]string,
) (slotPrepareResult, SemanticResult, string, error) {
    var (
       slotResult     slotPrepareResult
       semanticResult SemanticResult
       rewrittenQuery string
    )

    eg := pkg_util.NewErrGroup()
    eg.Go(ctx, "vqa.prepare_slot", func() error {
       slotData, vehicleControlResp, err := prepareSlotResult(ctx, req, commonOutput)
       if err != nil {
          return err
       }
       slotResult = slotPrepareResult{
          SlotData:           slotData,
          VehicleControlResp: vehicleControlResp,
       }
       return nil
    })
    eg.Go(ctx, "vqa.prepare_semantic", func() error {
       semanticResult = prepareSemanticResult(req)
       return nil
    })
    eg.Go(ctx, "vqa.prepare_location", func() error {
       locationQuery, ok := buildLocationRewriteQuery(ctx, req)
       if ok {
          rewrittenQuery = locationQuery
       }
       return nil
    })

    if err := eg.Wait(); err != nil {
       return slotPrepareResult{}, SemanticResult{}, "", err
    }
    return slotResult, semanticResult, rewrittenQuery, nil
}

多轮语义模型&车位置

func prepareSemanticResult(req *types.ChatRequest) SemanticResult {
    _ = req
    // TODO: 接入多轮语义模型，输入当前 query + 最近 5 轮历史，
    // 输出 time_slot / rear_screen_enabled。
    return SemanticResult{}
}

func buildLocationRewriteQuery(ctx context.Context, req *types.ChatRequest) (string, bool) {
    locationInfo, err := infra_location.ResolveGPS(ctx, req.CommonInfo.Longitude, req.CommonInfo.Latitude)
    if err != nil || locationInfo == nil || locationInfo.GetPlace() == nil {
       return "", false
    }

    city := strings.TrimSpace(locationInfo.GetPlace().GetLocality())
    district := strings.TrimSpace(locationInfo.GetPlace().GetSubLocality())
    if city == "" || district == "" {
       return "", false
    }
    return fmt.Sprintf("现在我们位于%s%s，%s", city, district, req.Query.Content), true
}

取图

func BuildCaptureResult(ctx context.Context, req *types.ChatRequest, prepareResult PrepareResult) (CaptureResult, error) {
    if prepareResult.DirectModelContent != "" {
       return CaptureResult{}, nil
    }

    snapshot, reusable := loadReusableCaptureSnapshot(
       ctx,
       req,
       prepareResult.Scene,
       prepareResult.IsCabinEdgeScene,
       prepareResult.SemanticResult.TimeSlot,
    )
    if !prepareResult.IsCabinEdgeScene && reusable {
       return CaptureResult{
          Pictures:   snapshot.Pictures,
          CarHeading: snapshot.CarHeading,
       }, nil
    }

    if prepareResult.IsCabinEdgeScene {
       prepareClientVLMCaptureRequest(prepareResult.CaptureResp, req.Query.Content, snapshot, reusable)
    }

    result, err := executeCaptureRequest(ctx, req, prepareResult.CaptureResp, prepareResult.IsCabinEdgeScene)
    if err != nil {
       return CaptureResult{}, err
    }

    saveCaptureSnapshot(ctx, req, prepareResult.Scene, prepareResult.IsCabinEdgeScene, buildCaptureSnapshot(result))
    return result, nil
}


func loadReusableCaptureSnapshot(
    ctx context.Context,
    req *types.ChatRequest,
    scene Scene,
    isCabinEdgeScene bool,
    timeSlot string,
) (CaptureSnapshot, bool) {
    if !shouldReuseCaptureSnapshot(timeSlot) {
       return CaptureSnapshot{}, false
    }

    cacheKey := buildCaptureSnapshotCacheKey(req, scene, isCabinEdgeScene)
    data, err := cache.Get(ctx, cacheKey)
    if err != nil || len(data) == 0 {
       return CaptureSnapshot{}, false
    }

    var snapshot CaptureSnapshot
    if err := config.Json.Unmarshal(data, &snapshot); err != nil {
       log.AppLogger.Error(ctx, "loadReusableCaptureSnapshot unmarshal failed, err: %+v", err)
       return CaptureSnapshot{}, false
    }
    if time.Since(time.UnixMilli(snapshot.CreatedAtMillis)) > vqaCaptureSnapshotMaxAge {
       return CaptureSnapshot{}, false
    }
    return snapshot, true
}

主流程

func RunScene(
    ctx context.Context,
    request *types.ChatRequest,
    prepareResult PrepareResult,
    captureResult CaptureResult,
    ch chan<- *types.ChatResponse,
) error {
    if prepareResult.DirectModelContent != "" {
       ch <- types.NewModelContentChunk(prepareResult.DirectModelContent)
       return nil
    }

    if prepareResult.Scene != SceneLBS {
       ch <- buildVQAPictureWidgetChunk(captureResult.Pictures)
    }

    switch prepareResult.Scene {
    case SceneOutCar:
       return runOutCarScene(ctx, request, prepareResult, captureResult, ch)
    case SceneLBS:
       return runLBSScene(ctx, request, prepareResult, captureResult, ch)
    case SceneInCarMultiImage, SceneInCarSingleImage:
       return runInCarScene(ctx, request, prepareResult, captureResult, ch)
    default:
       return runCommonSceneFlow(ctx, request, prepareResult, captureResult, ch)
    }
}

LBS scene处理流程

func runLBSScene(
    ctx context.Context,
    request *types.ChatRequest,
    prepareResult PrepareResult,
    captureResult CaptureResult,
    ch chan<- *types.ChatResponse,
) error {
    vqaRespCh := make(chan *types.ChatResponse, 16)
    lbsResultCh := make(chan []*types.ChatResponse, 1)
    var lbsPictures []PictureItem

    pkg_util.GoSafe(ctx, "vqa.runLBSScene.vqa", func() {
       err := runCommonSceneFlow(ctx, request, prepareResult, captureResult, vqaRespCh)
       if err != nil {
          log.AppLogger.Error(ctx, "runLBSScene vqa failed, err: %+v", err)
       }
       close(vqaRespCh)
    })

    pkg_util.GoSafe(ctx, "vqa.runLBSScene.lbs", func() {
       responses, pictures, err := callLBSTool(ctx, request, captureResult.CarHeading)
       if err != nil {
          log.AppLogger.Error(ctx, "runLBSScene lbs failed, err: %+v", err)
       }
       lbsPictures = pictures
       lbsResultCh <- responses
    })

    vqaResponses := make([]*types.ChatResponse, 0)
    for resp := range vqaRespCh {
       vqaResponses = append(vqaResponses, resp)
    }
    lbsResponses := <-lbsResultCh

    picturesToEmit := captureResult.Pictures
    if len(lbsResponses) > 0 {
       if len(lbsPictures) > 0 {
          picturesToEmit = lbsPictures
       }
       ch <- buildVQAPictureWidgetChunk(picturesToEmit)
       for _, resp := range lbsResponses {
          ch <- resp
       }
       return nil
    }

    ch <- buildVQAPictureWidgetChunk(picturesToEmit)
    for _, resp := range vqaResponses {
       ch <- resp
    }
    return nil
}

舱内流程

func runInCarScene(
    ctx context.Context,
    request *types.ChatRequest,
    prepareResult PrepareResult,
    captureResult CaptureResult,
    ch chan<- *types.ChatResponse,
) error {
    if prepareResult.IsCabinEdgeScene {
       return runEdgeScene(captureResult, ch)
    }
    return runCommonSceneFlow(ctx, request, prepareResult, captureResult, ch)
}

func runEdgeScene(captureResult CaptureResult, ch chan<- *types.ChatResponse) error {
    if captureResult.DirectModelContent != "" {
       ch <- types.NewModelContentChunk(captureResult.DirectModelContent)
    }
    return nil
}

<comment comment-id="7699335901781495087" block-id="X7KodLZFRo7CJzxAPQachDt5n0f"><quote>客户端侧</quote><msg user="贾雪伟">需求4和5有遗漏，技术侧变动如下：
端侧待确认：若用户在系统设置中完全禁用了摄像头权限（非 Always On 开关），则不自动开启，按现有提示引导用户开启。 是否能获取系统设置？
端云调整：
1. 并发请求：若多个 VQA 请求同时到达，则所有请求取图完毕后再关闭摄像头（端侧实现）
2. 构图指令图片缓存参数变成picture_cache，如果复用图片，端上传的取图结果中capture_time应使用picture_cache携带的capture_time
3. 异常情况下，端侧找不到任一picture_id，应重新取图
4. camera_temporarily_opened，取图结果增加该字段，表示摄像头临时开启，云端下发“已临时打开摄像头”文本帧给DT总结，让用户感知；并发请求下，应只在开启的那一次请求传camera_temporarily_opened=true；没有临时开启，可不传该字段
5. 多图情况下，任一图片过期则全部重新取图
cc @张弛 @陈西钺 @高铖 @谢一鸣</msg></comment>
